report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency issues, but current telemetry contradicts it: gateway error_rate 0.001, p95 80ms, INFO 200 logs; order trace OK, error_rate 0.001, p95 80ms. Only a retained-heap WARN and 300MB retained bytes appear, insufficient to establish a memory leak. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause; hand off for more data.
missing_evidence: Traces showing order checkout errors or elevated latency; current order trace is OK at 1350ms with no error.
Gateway error-rate/latency metrics aligned with the alert; current gateway metrics show error_rate 0.001 and p95 80ms.
Time-series memory-retention data for order to distinguish a leak from a transient retained-heap warning.
Evidence linking the order 3.3.1 deployment to observed latency or errors.
